name: jev-response-check
goal: Harness checks supplied LLM answers against user requests and gates on confident success

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Approved request/answer scope with optional context and criteria; strict confident-success gate; six unchanged CLI regressions fail on unknown command and missing guide

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented explicit response-check CLI, typed JEV rubric, bounded UTF-8 inputs, sanitized reports, strict gate and generic JEV validation reuse

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Six original CLI regressions pass unchanged; 136 unit and 42 CLI E2E tests pass; 11 live jev-1.13.0 calibration cases match expected judgments

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: bun run check passes formatting, types, lint, unit/E2E tests, build and audit; built CLI manually checked against live JEV for strict success and formatting failure; frontend and deployment not applicable
